pages.title: The Legacy of Dard Hunter | Robert C. Williams Museum of Papermaking
pages.excerpt: Dard Hunter Gallery at the Robert C. Williams Museum of Papermaking Alice and Elbert Hubbard, founders of the Roycrofters, Photo courtesy of the Roycroft Campus Dard Hunter was born on November 29, 18
headings: Dard Hunter (1883-1966) is considered by many to be the father of hand papermaking in the United States. Hunter travelled extensively around the world, learning about papermaking and collecting artifacts related to the topic. He wrote several books on hand papermaking traditions, and also studied other paper-like materials such as papyrus and amatl.
